data.title: 雷电将军 · 天守深闺的紫纱微颤
data.description: 深夜静谧的天守阁寝殿内烛火摇曳。影身着一袭轻柔半透的深紫色雪纺薄纱睡裙，优雅地斜倚在织锦软枕堆上，一侧肩带自然滑落露出纤细雪白的锁骨与成熟圆润的肩线。长发如瀑散落于紫绸被褥，紫眸泛着微醺的水汽，带着仅在独处时展露的温存与依赖看向眼前之人——「唯独在此刻，卸下鸣神之责。靠近些，让我听听你的心音。」
data.action: 斜倚于锦榻紫绸软枕，深紫薄纱睡裙轻裹曼妙娇躯，单手抚过肩头锁骨，紫眸含情直视观众
data.lighting: 寝殿内摇曳暖烛与紫色边缘光
data.camera: from front, facing viewer, intimate medium shot, reclining pose
data.mood: 深宫独处时的卸防与深情
data.promptProse: Ei reclines across the silk tatami mats facing the viewer in a sheer dark purple babydoll that gracefully showcases her delicate collarbone, deep cleavage, and bare legs; tiny purple Electro sparks flicker around her flushed cheeks in the intimate amber lantern glow.
data.animaCaption: Reclining on the tatami facing the viewer, her sheer purple babydoll showcases her delicate collarbone, cleavage, and bare legs amid soft sparks.
